title: O*NET 13-1161.00 Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
rights: U.S. government work. O*NET content is in the public domain. Attribution retained.
retrieved_note: Pilot mapping from O*NET 13-1161.00 plus startup growth context. Labeled offline fixture; not live retrieval.

excerpts.text: Research market conditions in local, regional, or national areas, or gather information to determine potential sales of a product or service, or create a marketing campaign. May gather information on competitors, prices, sales, and methods of marketing and distribution.
Collect and analyze data on customer demographics, preferences, needs, and buying habits to identify potential markets and factors affecting product demand.
Measure the effectiveness of marketing, advertising, and communications programs and strategies.

labeled_tasks.statement: Collect and analyze data on customer demographics, preferences, needs, and buying habits to identify potential markets and factors affecting product demand.
labeled_tasks.output: A demand readout with named segments and uncertainties
labeled_tasks.success_criteria: Recommendations cite the data used and what remains unknown.

labeled_tasks.statement: Measure the effectiveness of marketing, advertising, and communications programs and strategies.
labeled_tasks.output: Experiment or campaign measurement with a decision
labeled_tasks.success_criteria: A ship, iterate, or stop decision is recorded with the metric used.

labeled_skills.description: Query product and funnel data without treating missing fields as facts.
